verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU cloud marketplace, so in-product AI insights, such as usage or cost recommendations, are a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no such feature. The `vastai` agent skill lets external AI coding assistants drive the platform, which is an adjacent capability rather than in-product insights. Serverless benchmark-driven scaling and DLPerf/reliability scores are automated metrics, not AI-generated suggestions from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
